accessible_project_probe.summary: The previously registered Susenas Project was identified and selected; no new Earth Engine registration is required.

scientific_effect: The cloud access gate is cleared. This is an operational result and does not itself answer the Phase 3 hypothesis.
cost_guardrail: No paid object storage and no national raster-stack download are required. The automated runner embeds the private coordinates transiently and returns only aggregate fractions for the 18664 locked analysis cells.
